After testing a bunch of perpetuals platforms lately, Hyperliquid stands out for how clean the order book feels and how little slippage there is even during volatility. Been running some positions there for the past couple weeks and it's become my default for perps.

Ran into this newer lending protocol called Morpho Blue the other day while looking for better rates on stablecoins. The way it aggregates isolated pools is actually pretty smart. Started moving some collateral over and the APYs are noticeably higher than what I was getting before.

Been following the developments on Berachain for a while now. The proof-of-liquidity concept seems like it could solve some real pain points in DeFi. Just bridged a bit over to test the ecosystem and things are moving smoothly so far.

If you're into restaking but tired of the usual suspects, EigenLayer has some interesting expansions lately with new AVS options. Been delegating a portion of my holdings there and the rewards structure looks sustainable long term.

Stumbled across Backpack wallet while setting up for Solana again. The built-in exchange and how it handles compressed NFTs is convenient. Switched my main Solana activity there and haven't had any issues since.

The recent upgrades on Celestia for modular data availability caught my attention. Been running some light nodes and the bandwidth requirements are reasonable. Feels like a solid piece of infrastructure if you're building rollups.

After comparing a few NFT marketplaces, Magic Eden still has the best flow for trading ordinal inscriptions right now. Been flipping a couple collections there and fees stay predictable even on busy days.

Just started using Pendle to split yield tokens and it's surprisingly straightforward once you get the hang of it. Been locking some positions and watching the points accumulate nicely without much active management.

This newer memecoin launcher on Base called Friend.tech 2.0 (not the original) has a different take on social tokens. Experimented with a small position and the bonding curve mechanics seem well tuned for early entry.
Been using Wormhole for cross-chain transfers more often lately. The security model with guardians and the speed improvements make it reliable compared to some of the older bridges I've used.
If you're looking for a decentralized perpetuals exchange with good liquidity, dYdX v4 on its own chain has been performing well for me. Execution is fast and funding rates are competitive right now.

Discovered this staking derivative protocol called Puffer Finance recently. The way it handles node operators and liquid staking seems more decentralized than some alternatives. Added some ETH to test it out.

The Ordinals ecosystem on Bitcoin has been picking up again with new inscription standards. Been minting a few smaller collections on Magic Eden Bitcoin and the community around certain projects feels active.
Started experimenting with ZKsync Era for some DeFi plays. Gas costs are low enough that I can do multiple transactions without thinking twice. Been building positions in a couple protocols there.

This AI agent framework called Fetch.ai has been quietly building out real use cases. Been running some of their autonomous agents for simple tasks and the integration with wallets is smoother than expected.

After trying several hardware wallets again, Tangem cards have been the most convenient for daily use. No cables, quick taps, and they support a wide range of chains now. Switched my smaller holdings over.
The new liquidity incentives on Aerodrome Finance on Base are pretty attractive right now. Been providing some stable pairs and the veAERO voting rewards add up faster than I anticipated.

Been using Rabby wallet as my main browser extension lately. The simulation before signing transactions has saved me from a couple sketchy approvals already. Solid upgrade from what I was using before.

This RWA tokenization platform called Centrifuge has some interesting pools live now. Started allocating a small amount to their tinlake tranches and the yield feels reasonable given the underlying assets.
If you're into prediction markets, Polymarket still has the cleanest interface and deepest liquidity for major events. Been placing a few positions there and settlements have been quick.
Just bridged over to Monad testnet to play around. The parallel execution feels noticeably faster than other L1s I've tried in dev environments. Excited to see what dApps launch there.
Been farming points on Blast with some bridged ETH. The yield layer on top of L2 makes the returns stack nicely without complicated strategies. Simple and effective so far.
This newer DEX aggregator called 1inch Fusion has been giving better routes on larger swaps lately. Been routing most of my trades through it and saving a decent amount on slippage.
The governance token for Arbitrum DAO has some interesting proposals coming up. Been voting with my delegation and following the treasury discussions. Active community compared to some other L2s.
Started using Safe wallets for multisig setups again. The new account abstraction features make recovery and batching much easier. Moved a couple important treasuries over recently.
